arxiv-1311-4136.title: Validity of covariance models for the analysis of geographical variation
arxiv-1311-4136.creator: Gilles Guillot
arxiv-1311-4136.description:
A 2013 arXiv research paper by Gilles Guillot. Due to the availability of large molecular data-sets, covariance
models are increasingly
used to describe the structure of genetic variation as an
alternative to more heavily parametrised biological models. We focus here on a class of parametric covariance models that
received sustained attention lately and show that the conditions
under which they are valid mathematical models have been overlooked
so far. We provide rigorous results for the construction of valid
covariance models in this family.

arxiv-2109-08237.title: Subtle Data Crimes: Naively training machine learning algorithms could lead to overly-optimistic results
arxiv-2109-08237.creator: Efrat Shimron, Jonathan I. Tamir, Ke Wang, Michael Lustig
arxiv-2109-08237.description: Abstract While open databases are an important resource in the Deep Learning (DL) era, they are sometimes used "off-label": data published for one task are used for training algorithms for a different one. This work aims to highlight that in some cases, this common practice may lead to biased, overly-optimistic results.

arxiv-2112-07052.description: Abstract We identify a ∼ \sim 600 pc-wide region of active star formation located within a tidal streamer of M82 via H α \alpha emission ( F H ​ α ∼ 6.5 × 10 − 14 F_{H\alpha}\sim 6.5\times 10^{-14} erg s -1 cm -2 ), using a pathfinder instrument based on the Dragonfly Telephoto Array.

arxiv-2112-10997.title: Hyperscaling analysis of a disorder-induced ferromagnetic quantum critical point in Ni 1-x Rh x with x = 0.375 x=0.375
arxiv-2112-10997.creator: R.-Z. Lin, C.-L. Huang
arxiv-2112-10997.description: Abstract Here we report on hyperscaling analysis on thermodynamic measurements as a function of temperature and magnetic field for Ni 1-x Rh x with x = 0.375 x=0.375 where a ferromagnetic quantum critical point has been recently identified [Phys. Rev. Lett. 124 , 117203 (2020)].

arxiv-2210-03400.title: Computational imaging with the human brain
arxiv-2210-03400.creator: G. Wang 1 , D. Faccio 1
arxiv-2210-03400.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by G. Wang 1 , D. Faccio 1. Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) are enabling a range of new possibilities and routes for augmenting human capability. Here, we propose BCIs as a route towards forms of computation, i.e. computational imaging, that blend the brain with external silicon processing. We demonstrate ghost imaging of a hidden scene using the human visual system that is combined with an adaptive computational imaging scheme.

arxiv-2305-07292.title: On Authentication against a Myopic Adversary using Stochastic Codes Thanks: This material is based upon work supported by the National Science Foundation under Grant No. CCF-1908725 and CCF-2107526. Author emails: mayank.bakshi@ieee.org, okosut@asu.edu.
arxiv-2305-07292.creator: Mayank Bakshi, Oliver Kosut
arxiv-2305-07292.description: Abstract We consider the problem of authenticated communication over a discrete arbitrarily varying channel where the legitimate parties are unaware of whether or not an adversary is present. When there is no adversary, the channel state always takes a default value ∅ \emptyset .

arxiv-2405-06348.title: Local topology and perestroikas in protein structure and folding dynamics
arxiv-2405-06348.creator: Alexander Begun, Maxim N. Chernodub, Alexander Molochkov, Antti J. Niemi
arxiv-2405-06348.description: Abstract Methods of local topology are introduced to the field of protein physics. This is achieved by explaining how the folding and unfolding processes of a globular protein alter the local topology of the protein’s C α \alpha backbone through conformational bifurcations.

arxiv-2406-14652.title: Singular knee identification to support emergence recognition in physical swarm and cellular automata trajectories
arxiv-2406-14652.creator: Imraan A. Faruque, Ishriak Ahmed
arxiv-2406-14652.description: Abstract After decades of attention, emergence continues to lack a centralized mathematical definition that leads to a rigorous emergence test applicable to physical flocks and swarms, particularly those containing both deterministic elements (eg, interactions) and stochastic perturbations like measurement noise.

plos-pone-0351155.creator: Fangping Chen, Xingyue Guo, Dingyuan Wei, Mengxing Wang, Jiayan Wang, Didi Xu, Luyang Jin, Surui Liang
plos-pone-0351155.description: Frailty in older maintenance hemodialysis patients: A latent class analysis revealing personalized management

pmc-10505934.title: Spatial Centrosome Proteomic Profiling of Human iPSC-derived Neural Cells
pmc-10505934.creator: Fatma Uzbas, Adam C O’Neill
pmc-10505934.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The centrosome governs many pan-cellular processes including cell division, migration, and cilium formation. However, very little is known about its cell type-specific protein composition and the sub-organellar domains where these protein interactions take place.

pmc-10532051.title: Safety and Efficiency of Low-Dose Spinal Analgesia Compared to Epidural Analgesia in Treatment of Pain during Labour: A Case Control Study
pmc-10532051.creator: Martin Calineata, Lukas Jennewein, Vanessa Neef, Armin Niklas Flinspach, Frank Louwen, Kai Zacharowski, Florian Jürgen Raimann, Kassiani Theodoraki, Michael Froelich
pmc-10532051.description: Background: The epidural catheter for analgesia has been used for decades and has become the gold standard in pain therapy for pregnant women in labour. However, procedural parameters such as time to pain relief and duration to implementation pose hurdles for patients shortly before delivery.

pmc-11474451.title: Predicting the effect of framework and hydrocarbon structure on the zeolite-catalyzed beta-scission†
pmc-11474451.creator: Yannick Ureel, Konstantinos Alexopoulos, Kevin M. Van Geem, Maarten K. Sabbe
pmc-11474451.description: Developing improved zeolites is essential in novel sustainable processes such as the catalytic pyrolysis of plastic waste. This study used density functional theory to investigate how alkyl chain length, unsaturated bonds, and branching affect β-scission kinetics in four zeolite frameworks, a key reaction in hydrocarbon cracking.

pmc-11546383.title: Comparative Experimental Evaluation of Orthodontic Appliances for Maxillary Arch Expansion
pmc-11546383.creator: Ghazal Ebrahimy, Anna Konermann, Tarek El-Bialy, Ludger Keilig, Christoph Bourauel, Antonella Polimeni
pmc-11546383.description: Background/Objectives: The orthodontic treatment of posterior crossbite using appliances for gradual maxillary expansion is crucial to ensure proper transversal jaw relationships as much as occlusal functionality. The aim of this study was to analyze forces and torques generated by different appliances for maxillary expansion.

pmc-12594967.title: Metabolites associated with abnormal glucose metabolism responding to primary care lifestyle intervention
pmc-12594967.creator: Ville M Koistinen, Suvi Manninen, Marjo Tuomainen, Kirsikka Aittola, Elina Järvelä-Reijonen, Tanja Tilles-Tirkkonen, Reija Männikkö, Niina Lintu, Leila Karhunen, Marjukka Kolehmainen, Santtu Mikkonen, Marko Lehtonen, Janne Martikainen, Kaisa Poutanen, Ursula Schwab, Pilvikki Absetz, Jaana Lindström,
pmc-12594967.description: Type 2 diabetes can be prevented by lifestyle intervention. We aimed to identify metabolites that associate with glucose metabolism and respond to lifestyle intervention with evidence-based targets for nutrition and physical activity in individuals at high risk of type 2 diabetes.

pmc-12611158.title: Human capital’s dual impact: Advancing innovation and technology diffusion in ASEAN-5 through the Nelson-Phelps-Romer Lens
pmc-12611158.creator: Nguyen Ngoc Thach, Rogis Baker, Rogis Baker, Rogis Baker
pmc-12611158.description: The advanced ASEAN nations—Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, and Thailand—are navigating significant global uncertainties that challenge their industrialization ambitions. Human capital, recognized as a pivotal driver of technological progress, has not been adequately integrated into growth models for these countries.

pmc-12728184.title: Loss of vegetation functions during the Paleocene–Eocene Thermal Maximum
pmc-12728184.creator: Julian Rogger, Vera A Korasidis, Gabriel J Bowen, Christine A Shields, Taras V Gerya, Loïc Pellissier
pmc-12728184.description: The Paleocene–Eocene Thermal Maximum (PETM) around 56 million years ago was a 5–6°C global warming event that lasted for approximately 200 kyr. A warming-induced loss and a 70–100 kyr lagged recovery of biospheric carbon stocks was suggested to have contributed to the long duration of the climate perturbation.

pmc-12750590.title: Development and validation of an artificial intelligence-based model for cardiovascular disease prediction using longitudinal data
pmc-12750590.creator: Maryam Mahdavi, Anoshirvan Kazemnejad, Abbas Asosheh, Davood Khalili, Ahmadreza Tajari, Kamyab Hosseinpour
pmc-12750590.description: BackgroundThis research uses machine learning (ML) models to determine significant predictive factors for CVD events in Iran, a country with high mortality rates. The study evaluates the effectiveness of deep learning and mixed-effects logistic models in predicting 10-year CVD incidence using longitudinal TLGS data.

pmc-13001930.title: A hybrid deep learning and residual connection-based architecture for intrusion detection in autonomous vehicles
pmc-13001930.creator: Hareem Kibriya, Ayesha Siddiqa, Saad Alahmari, Wazir Zada Khan, Saad Nasser Altamimi, Atta ur Rehman Khan, Ayei Ibor, Ayei Ibor, Ayei Ibor
pmc-13001930.description: The emergence of Autonomous and Connected Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs) has transformed the automotive landscape drastically over the past few years by offering enhanced features in the vehicles for drivers’ safety and convenience. These developments have introduced various features in AVs i.e., lane-keeping, cruise control, etc.

pmc-13161306.title: Dental age estimation: a scoping review comparing the manual application of the Demirjian method and artificial intelligence modalities
pmc-13161306.creator: Stephanie Baylis, Joanna F Dipnall, Richard Bassed
pmc-13161306.description: The investigation of the viability using Artificial intelligence (AI) compared to the Demirjian method in dental age estimation is growing. This scoping review looked at how AI-assisted dental age estimation models compare to the Demirjian method and their usefulness to general and forensic dentists.

pmc-13387847.title: Long-Term Trends of Distal Radius Fractures in Adults Aged ≥ 50 Years in Korea Using Nationwide Claims Database (2006–2022)
pmc-13387847.creator: Jae-Hwi Nho, Seong-Jun Kim, Tae-Young Kim, Kyungjun Lim, Jaiyong Kim, Jihye Kim, Hoyeon Jang, Yong-Chan Ha
pmc-13387847.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to evaluate the long-term trends in the incidence, mortality, and subsequent fractures following distal radius fractures among South Koreans aged ≥ 50 years based on a nationwide claims database from 2006 to 2022.MethodsUsing the National Health Insurance database, we identified individuals aged ≥ 50 years who received treatment for distal radius fractures from 2006 to 2022.

pmc-13443200.title: Combined Red Cell Exchange and Plasma Exchange for Post-Arrest Refractory Cardiorespiratory Failure in Sickle Cell Disease Sparing Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation
pmc-13443200.creator: Ashraf Ezzat Attia

pmc-13607732.title: Indications for Biological Treatment Combined with Allergen-Specific Immunotherapy: Who Is It Really Intended for?
pmc-13607732.creator: Mirjana Turkalj, Ivana Banić
pmc-13607732.description: Allergen-specific immunotherapy (AIT) is a well-proven treatment for allergic diseases and conditions such as Hymenoptera venom allergy, allergic rhinitis, allergic asthma, and, in recent years, food allergy. In order to enhance the efficacy and safety of allergen immunotherapy, biological agents such as omalizumab and dupilumab have been introduced.
